senses.gloss: f. a phonetic rendition of <cite ref="S02246"><he>קְשִׂיטָה</he></cite> q. v.
units: Gen. R. s. 79 (corr. vers. after Ar. s. v. קשיטה) (they heard one woman say to another) אשאלי לי כְּסִיתְּתָךְ (for קשיטתך, meaning to say מרגליתיך); (and furthermore) אפיק הדא כ׳ למרעיא lead this K’sitta out to pasture (meaning to say אִימַּרְתָּא); [Ar. reads קשיט׳].
